project_type: AWS CDK v2 (TypeScript) infra + Python 3.12 Lambda sources + dependency-light vanilla-JS SPA. Two stacks: SecureAssistantSecurityData and SecureAssistantAppEdgeAI.
build_system: infra: npm + TypeScript (npx tsc --noEmit) + AWS CDK CLI (npx cdk). app: no build, py_compile + pytest. QUIRK: the assistant Lambda is an OUT-OF-BAND ECR container image (repo 'session5-secure-assistant', tag :latest) built+pushed by deploy.sh step 3b via docker buildx --provenance=false --sbom=false --platform linux/amd64; `cdk deploy` does NOT rebuild it, so any app/assistant/*.py change requires a manual rebuild+push before the AppEdgeAI deploy.
test_framework: Python: pytest (app/tests, conftest.py puts app/ on sys.path). Infra: a bespoke assert harness in infra/test/template.test.ts run via `npm test` (ts-node, NOT jest); it uses Template.fromStack + Match.arrayWith/objectLike and process.exit(1) on failure.

test_command: python3 -m pytest app/tests -q  (run from repo root); cd infra && npm test

contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md present. README 'Local verification' section is the authority: infra tsc+synth+npm test, python py_compile+pytest, node check on spa, bash -n on scripts. Keep the pinned toolchain (no jest, no new infra deps). Python modules stay importable WITHOUT boto3/strands (guarded try/except imports) so py_compile and pytest work without those packages.
key_patterns: Guarded heavy imports: `try: import boto3 except Exception: boto3=None` and a fallback identity `tool` decorator in tools.py so modules import under test. Tool FACTORIES: make_place_order/make_look_up_order/make_initiate_refund(bindings...) return an inner @tool. AUTHORITATIVE SIDE CHANNEL: tools append records to req_ctx (pending_refunds/placed_orders); handler.build_response reads req_ctx[-1] and emits envelope objects (pendingRefund/placedOrder) — URLs/tokens are NEVER parsed from model text. PII masked/validated in the tool layer (pii.py) because the guardrail does not see tool args/results. Presign: app/presign/handler.py has generate_url(s3_client,bucket,order_id,expires_in=900), ORDER_ID_RE ^ORD-[0-9]{6}$, EXPIRES_IN=900, and an inline SigV4+regional boto3 s3 client (signature_version s3v4, virtual addressing, endpoint https://s3.<region>.amazonaws.com) that must be factored into a shared make_s3_presign_client(region) helper reused by both the presign Lambda and the new tool. SPA renderPendingRefund builds DOM via createElement/textContent (no innerHTML for untrusted values).
